meta.name: Rack Focus
meta.notes: Espresso ground stays fixed; primary fills the CTA buttons, cart count and a 16% tint on the CTA band, while accent (mixed toward ivory so any hue stays legible) drives the focus brackets, tags and focal-plane marks.

issues: Stress brand: footer wordmark 'Kartstore International' in 125%-wide Kalnia with unbreakable words pushes the page wider than the viewport (horizontal overflow)

Depth of field too binary: the focal plane is a single line, so anything not exactly on it hits max blur; row text at half strength (3px) is unreadable, so whole sections look broken instead of cinematic
Catalog opens with every card blurred and card titles illegible until the pointer moves, so the grid reads as a loading glitch
Hero frame ticks ('NN — 3:2', 'f / 1.4') sit under the frame and collide with the heavy headline word that overlaps the frame bottom
Toast ('Added') is only shifted 160% down, so it peeks into captures and short viewports at rest
The focal plane mark is a static 'Focus' label: the signature has no readout that ties the lens metaphor to the content
fixed: Footer wordmark is fitted to its longest word (re-measured on resize and fonts.ready) and the footer clips horizontally as a safety net, which removes the stress overflow

Depth curve gets a real depth of field: a sharp band of ±8% vh around the plane (60px radially in the catalog), and text uses a lighter 0.4 curve (max ~2.4px) so it reads as soft focus and stays legible
Catalog rests focus on the first card in view before the pointer arrives (a lens parked on the lead product); pointer and keyboard pin still take over
Frame ticks moved inside the 3:2 frame's top corners as small frosted camera-HUD chips, and accent hairline focus marks were added at the frame's left and right edges on desktop
Toast is fully hidden (visibility + offset) until shown
Focal plane label is now a live lens readout ('Focus · 02 / 03', '∞' when nothing is locked) that updates as rows or cards come into focus
